mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) falls below 50,000 jobs, it indicates a slowing labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 50000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers a decline in equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline by more than 0.2% from the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-interest-rate regime (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), the cost of capital rises, reducing corporate investment and profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%.
